components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Terracotta action with physical pressed feedback and a forest focus ring.

components.name: Decision Surface
components.description: A readable paper plane that changes fill, border, icon, and language when selected.
components.css: .decision-option { min-height: 66px; padding: 15px 18px; border: 1px solid #c9bda5; border-radius: 14px; background: #f6edda; }

narrative.overview: The family reveals one illustrated page at a time, then places responsibilities, contacts, transport choices, and prepared items into one shared plan. Future scenes remain hidden until the current conversation is complete.
keyCharacteristics: Gated single-scene progression instead of a long scroll

rules.name: The Action Color Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only primary action color. Sage and ochre communicate state.

dos: Let the supplied illustrations carry emotional tone.
Show only the current scene and one obvious next action.
Use large touch targets and visible focus.
donts: Do not use scores or countdowns.
Do not add unsupported cultural motifs.
Do not use glass, neon, or medical stock imagery.
